meta.designSystemPrefixApp: GeFi App Design System — dark-first, for platform/app screens (the marketing site keeps designSystemPrefix). Canvas near-black #0A0C14; surface #12141F with 1px border #232636, hover #161927; text #F2F4FF, muted #8A91A6. Brand indigo #6D5BFF (primary buttons, active tabs, selection, progress bars, hero metrics); accent cyan #22D3EE sparingly. Semantics: positive/compliant green #22C55E; negative/critical red #EF4444; warning/pending amber #F59E0B; high-risk/overdue orange #F97316; info blue #3B82F6; contributors/completed purple #A78BFA; neutral gray #6B7280. Radius 12px cards / 8px controls / 999px chips; separation by surface+border, minimal shadows. Inter for UI; JetBrains Mono tabular for all numerics; currency with thousands separators; dates 'Jan 15, 2026'; deltas signed with icon AND color, never color alone. Every screen wears the app shell: top bar (indigo rounded-square brain logo + GeFi wordmark; persona icon, search, bell with unread dot, theme toggle, globe+Language, avatar), icon+label persona tab nav (active = indigo pill), page header (bold H1 + muted subtitle; at most ONE filled indigo action, others ghost), content on the near-black canvas, trust badge strip (SSL Secured green, SOC 2 blue, GDPR purple, ISO 27001 amber, 99.9% SLA green), and the mega footer (brand blurb + Enterprise Security / Bank-Grade Encryption pills; Platform / Legal & Privacy / Support & Contact columns; 'Your data is encrypted and never shared with third parties' + Zero Data Retention / AI Models Run Locally / End-to-End Encrypted; (c) 2026 GeFi Technologies, Version 1.0 pill, 'Built with love for financial professionals', 'Trusted by 10,000+ users'). harness.title: Model Page Harness
harness.whyFirst: Ninety-two model prompts used to each say “extend _layouts/model.html” — run more than a couple and they collide in the same file. This prompt builds the front-matter-driven demo/analytics machinery once; after it merges, every model build prompt below is content-only and they can run in parallel safely.

prompts.claudeCode: Build the Model Page Harness in the gefi repo — one turn, merged before any individual model page. Extend `_layouts/model.html` plus a new `assets/js/model-demo.js` so “Try it” and “Live analytics” render entirely from front-matter: a `demo:` block (input fields with name/type/label, output type: score | curve | table | text) and an `analytics: true` flag. The form POSTs to `{{ site.api.base_url }}/v1/models/{slug}/run` when configured and falls back to a seeded local mock otherwise; charts reuse the SVG primitives from `assets/js/dashboard.js`; keep the no-JS fallback. After this merges, every model prompt is content-only (`_models/*.md` plus a dashboard MODELS row) and must not touch the layout. Build with `JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build`.
